title: RoqueOS / CasaOS App Manifest
description: docker-compose.yml superset used by the RoqueOS Server catalog. Compatible with CasaOS App Store; adds the optional x-roqueos namespace for RoqueOS-specific metadata. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full contributor guide.

name.description: Stack name (top-level Docker Compose key). Lowercase, no spaces.

services.description: Map of service name → service definition. The principal service is identified by x-casaos.main (required when more than one service is declared).

image.description: Image reference. Must include an explicit tag or digest (no bare names). Accepted shapes: 'name:tag', 'name@sha256:...', 'name:tag@sha256:...'. :latest is allowed but discouraged — the fix-manifests script reports it as 'manual review' so contributors can pin to stable tags during normal maintenance.

x-casaos.description: Per-service metadata (port descriptions, env hints, volume hints).
App-level metadata consumed by RoqueOS Server (catalog parser) and CasaOS-compatible clients.

architectures.description: Architectures the image supports. The server checks this against process.arch before pulling and rejects with INCOMPATIBLE_ARCH if unsupported.

main.description: Name of the principal service in `services`. The catalog parser uses this to pick the right image when a stack has helpers (databases, workers). Required because services are an unordered map — falling back to the first key is unstable.

category.description: Display category. The RoqueOS Server normalizes some variants (Utility→Utilities, Games→Gaming) but for new apps prefer the canonical form. Categories not in catalog-list.json fall back to 'other' in the UI.

scheme.description: Protocol the WebUI speaks. Used by the proxy to construct the open URL.

port_map.description: Canonical published host port the proxy should open by default. Required when the principal service exposes 2+ ports (otherwise the proxy heuristic guesses).

x-roqueos.description: RoqueOS-specific extensions. All optional, all opt-in. Does not affect CasaOS-compatible clients.

mountShared.description: When true, the RoqueOS Server bind-mounts /data/roqueos/shared at /shared inside the container (rw). Use for media servers, downloaders, and file managers that benefit from cross-app access to a shared filesystem.

i18nString.description: Multi-locale string keyed by language code (e.g. en_US, pt_BR, es_ES). At minimum en_US should be present.
